description: Shared persistent notification model for Tempo components.

members.name: RecipientUserId
members.description: Recipient user id for hosts that do not have a full user snapshot.

members.name: Actor
members.description: User that caused the notification, when known.

members.name: Type
members.description: Notification type key, for example mention or page-edited.

members.name: CreatedAt
members.description: UTC timestamp when the notification was created.

members.name: ReadAt
members.description: UTC timestamp when the recipient read the notification.

members.name: ActionUrl
members.description: Optional URL opened when the notification is clicked.

members.name: EntityRef
members.description: Optional entity related to the notification.

members.name: CorrelationId
members.description: Optional correlation identifier used to group related notifications.

members.name: IsRead
members.description: Returns true when the notification has been read.
